import json
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/work')
from harness import run, check_plan

FAIL = []


def expect(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAIL.append(name)
        print('FAIL %s\n  got  %s\n  want %s' % (name, json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True),
                                                json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True)))
    else:
        print('ok   %s' % name)


BOOK = {"id": "b1", "owner": "bob", "window": [0, 100], "envelope": [[0, 8]]}

reqs = [
    {"op": "load", "n": 3, "links": [[0, 1, 10], [1, 2, 10]],
     "bookings": [BOOK]},
    {"op": "audit", "at": [0, 50]},
    # lowering the capacity below the booked rate is blocked
    {"op": "edit", "rev": 0, "changes": [[0, 5]], "force": False},
    # a safe edit succeeds
    {"op": "edit", "rev": 0, "changes": [[0, 9]], "force": False},
    {"op": "audit", "at": [0]},
    # forcing revokes the lease
    {"op": "edit", "rev": 1, "changes": [[0, 3]], "force": True},
    {"op": "audit", "at": [0]},
    {"op": "commit", "id": "b1", "owner": "bob", "rev": 2},
    # forcing with an increase does not revoke
    {"op": "edit", "rev": 2, "changes": [[0, 30]], "force": True},
    # equal capacity writes do not revoke
    {"op": "edit", "rev": 3, "changes": [[0, 30]], "force": True},
]

out = run(reqs)
expect('audit', out[1], {"status": "ok", "rev": 0, "now": 0, "leases": ["b1"],
                         "samples": [[0, [2, 10]], [50, [2, 10]]]})
expect('edit blocked', out[2], {"status": "blocked", "rev": 0, "link": 0, "time": 0,
                                "used": 8, "capacity": 5})
expect('edit safe', out[3], {"status": "ok", "rev": 1, "cancelled": []})
expect('audit2', out[4], {"status": "ok", "rev": 1, "now": 0, "leases": ["b1"],
                          "samples": [[0, [1, 10]]]})
expect('edit force', out[5], {"status": "ok", "rev": 2, "cancelled": ["b1"]})
expect('audit3', out[6], {"status": "ok", "rev": 2, "now": 0, "leases": [],
                          "samples": [[0, [3, 10]]]})
expect('commit gone', out[7], {"status": "error", "code": "GONE", "rev": 2})
expect('edit force increase', out[8], {"status": "ok", "rev": 3, "cancelled": []})
expect('edit force equal', out[9], {"status": "ok", "rev": 4, "cancelled": []})

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# expiry
reqs = [
    {"op": "load", "n": 2, "links": [[0, 1, 10]],
     "bookings": [{"id": "b1", "owner": "bob", "window": [0, 10], "envelope": [[0, 3]]},
                  {"id": "b2", "owner": "bob", "window": [20, 30], "envelope": [[0, 4]]}]},
    {"op": "advance", "time": 10},
    {"op": "audit", "at": [10]},
    {"op": "commit", "id": "b1", "owner": "bob", "rev": 1},
    {"op": "advance", "time": 25},
    {"op": "audit", "at": [25]},
]
out = run(reqs)
expect('advance expire', out[1], {"status": "ok", "rev": 1, "now": 10, "expired": ["b1"]})
expect('audit after expiry', out[2], {"status": "ok", "rev": 1, "now": 10, "leases": ["b2"],
                                      "samples": [[10, [6, ]]]})
expect('commit expired', out[3], {"status": "error", "code": "GONE", "rev": 1})
expect('advance expire 2', out[4], {"status": "ok", "rev": 2, "now": 25, "expired": ["b2"]})
expect('audit after expiry 2', out[5], {"status": "ok", "rev": 2, "now": 25, "leases": [],
                                        "samples": [[25, [10]]]})

print()
print('FAILURES: %d' % len(FAIL))
PYEOF
